_comment: PKT-379: tools/ascii_check.py. The files that carried a non-ASCII byte (each a U+00A7 SECTION SIGN in a comment) when the check landed, with their exact count of non-ASCII lines. Debt, not exemption: no book needs a non-ASCII byte. Rewriting them recertifies 32 books including books/records and books/cbor, so it rides the next closure recertification (PKT-496); --strict fails when a count changes or a file is clean, so the list only shrinks.
